market_summary: Broad market shows dominant USD strength and crypto liquidation across all pairs during the London/NY Overlap session. All 4 assets are trading well below their respective session Value Area Lows (VAL), VWAPs, and EMA50 baselines with expanding ATR bands and bearish CVD readings. However, after substantial multi-leg downside flushes, price action is currently consolidating or exhibiting minor exhaustion bounces near session support extremes, warranting a disciplined HOLD across the board to avoid chasing extended impulse moves.

signals.rationale: Price is trading well below VAL (3926.34) and below POC (3978.13), indicating an extreme downward value area imbalance. CVD is -9.43 with a BEARISH label, confirming strong selling pressure, though the short-term slope (+0.59) reflects slight consolidation. We are in the LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session. Trend is firmly bearish below both VWAP (3943.43) and EMA50 (3931.37). Candles have been riding the lower ATR band (3874.80) with expanding ATR. RVOL is currently 1.142 (no recent yellow spike), showing exhaustion near the Session Low support at 3852.35. GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING below the Gamma Flip (3885.57) and sitting just below Put Wall #2 (3876.18), meaning dealers amplify downward moves; however, price is heavily stretched and consolidating just above Session Low with Put Wall #1 at 3821.59. Risk of an oversold mean-reversion snapback makes shorting extended lows unfavorable.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downward sloping VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection of lower ATR band bounce near Session Low 3852.35

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (1.10780) and below POC (1.10943). CVD is -3986.06 (NEUTRAL) with a sharp negative slope (-1835.90) reflecting sustained downward delta. Current session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price remains capped below both VWAP (1.10839) and EMA50 (1.10843). ATR is expanding vs 20-bar average, with recent candles testing and pushing through the lower ATR band (1.10617). Recent breakout lacked immediate yellow RVOL (rvol_last 1.019, 10 bars since spike). The signal candle attempted a pullback but is currently rejecting the S/R resistance at 1.10662 while hovering near Session Low (1.10533). Mid-range consolidation following an impulse requires HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below descending VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is established below VAL (1.32557) and below POC (1.32731). CVD is deeply negative at -11131.45 (BEARISH) with downward cvd_slope (-750.70), fully aligning with the ongoing markdown. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Structural trend is firmly bearish under VWAP (1.32608) and EMA50 (1.32617). ATR channel is expanding with price probing the lower ATR band (1.32333). RVOL is elevated at 1.601, although yellow >2.0 RVOL occurred earlier at the breakdown. Signal candle printed a small green bounce off Session Low (1.32210), leaving price mid-range between support and broken S/R at 1.32500. Without a fresh clean sweep or pullback into resistance, the risk/reward for immediate continuation is degraded.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish trading well below downward VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance below S/R 1.32500 and testing lower ATR band

signals.rationale: Price is positioned far below VAL (72635.05) and below POC (73501.60). CVD is -0.08 (BEARISH) with slightly positive short-term delta slope (+0.01). Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Overall trend remains heavily bearish below VWAP (72990.54) and EMA50 (72804.62). ATR is expanding, and price recently broke below the lower ATR band (71465.94). RVOL sits at 1.084 (no fresh yellow spike; last spike was 11 bars ago). Signal candle executed a sweep of the 71141.0 Session Low and closed back up as a cyan hammer/reversal bar into 71629.80. Given the severe extension below the value area and clean sweep of session lows, shorting here would be chasing into an oversold reaction, while longing goes against the macro momentum.

signals.level_event: sweep of Session Low 71141.0 followed by minor bounce
